aggressive_definition: Aggressiveness of incident prostate cancer determined according to the ISUP classification.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: The aggressiveness of PCa was determined according to the ISUP classification.
grading_caveat: The abstract does not report the ISUP Grade Group threshold or categories used to define aggressive disease.
reason: The abstract analyzes total incident prostate cancer and explicitly states that the overall recommendation-compliance association was also examined by aggressiveness.

exposures.supporting_excerpt: This association also was observed when the aggressiveness was considered. In addition, limiting consumption of "fast foods", sugar-sweetened drinks, and alcohol were independently associated with lower risk of PCa.
exposures.endpoint_definition: Incident prostate cancer; no alcohol-specific aggressive endpoint is stated.
exposures.reason: The aggressive analysis refers to the overall compliance score. Alcohol is independently associated only with PCa generally, so the score's aggressive association cannot be transferred to alcohol.
